summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block), added the numpy and torch.nn.functional imports, added the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias, and exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py. Added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class cases. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so tests and line-length checks are unverified; the expected values (batch-coupling TP=0.8, D=2.4, loss 0.333; empty-class 0 and 1) were checked by hand. Changes are uncommitted. One deviation: the local copy of the distance matrix is also cast to the probabilities' dtype, so the loss stays float32 when the matrix came from numpy.
